name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端：免装 Node.js，开箱即用，支持 Harness 在线升级
author: moon

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/check-win-build.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/verify-win-package.mjs
scripts.dist:win:zip: npm run build && electron-builder --win zip --x64 && node scripts/verify-win-package.mjs
scripts.prepare:win: node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && node scripts/seed-runtime.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64
